result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant card and one partially visible category filter button.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with both the image and the restaurant name truncated mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container shows a consistent partial peek of the next card to indicate scrollability, or adjust card sizing so names are not cut off mid-word. Consider adding a text ellipsis or limiting the visible name gracefully.

issues.description: The last category filter pill (after 'Healthy') is partially visible at the right edge of the filter row, showing only a small arc of the button without any readable label.
issues.suggestion: This is likely intentional to hint at horizontal scrollability, but the truncation is too severe — showing less than 10% of the button. Show at least 30-40% of the next pill so users clearly understand they can scroll.
